# ParaSwap

> ParaSwap is a DEX aggregator that routes a token swap across many liquidity sources on several EVM chains. This page is a non-custodial interface: you connect your own wallet and sign every transaction. It explains how aggregation works, what a swap costs and how to stay safe.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- ParaSwap is a DEX aggregator for ERC-20 token swaps on several EVM chains.
- Orders can be split across liquidity sources to reduce price impact.
- Costs are gas in the chain's native coin plus pool fees and price impact shown in the quote.
- ERC-20 tokens need a one-time approval; native coins do not.
- The interface is non-custodial and never holds funds or private keys.

## Pages

- ParaSwap & learn: https://paraswap-app.github.io/
- Legal: https://paraswap-app.github.io/legal.html
